fact: The director general of digital transformation states that Burkina Faso's interoperability referential was adopted in 2018, exists online, is used, and must be updated; the platform go-live check under the decree looks at interoperability principles.
title: Burkina : « Le crédo actuellement, c'est l'hébergement national pour des questions de souveraineté », Teg-Wendé Idriss Tinto, DG de la Transformation digitale
